slots.name: talks probability
slots.sentence: South Korea’s spy agency told lawmakers Wednesday that it assessed there was about a 50% chance of U.S.-North Korea talks occurring around November, when Trump plans to travel to Asia to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China.
